title: CodeChallenge: Zipf's law in characters and tokens

cues.en: I bet you're already intrigued by the title of this video.
cues.zh: 我猜你已經被這支影片的標題吸引。

cues.en: What is Zipf's law and what does this have to do with Tokenizers?

cues.en: It's just a fascinating aspect of language and also myriad other things that humans have encountered and measured.
cues.zh: 而是語言，以及人類遇過、量測過的無數其他事物中，一個迷人的現象。

cues.en: And it just fits really well into this section.
cues.zh: 它很適合放在這一章。

cues.en: And I think you're going to find this code challenge to be interesting and fun.
cues.zh: 我想，你會覺得這個程式挑戰有趣又好玩。

cues.en: So Zipf was a computational linguist, meaning that he studied the structure of language from mathematical
cues.zh: Zipf 是一位計算語言學家，也就是從數學

cues.en: principles.
cues.zh: 原理研究語言結構的人。

cues.en: One of his important contributions to the field of computational linguistics was the discovery that
cues.zh: 他對計算語言學的重要貢獻之一，是發現，

cues.en: if you make a plot of the frequency of a word by the rank of the frequency of the word, then that relationship is proportional in log space.
cues.zh: 如果把單字頻率，對照該頻率的排名畫圖，兩者在對數空間中呈比例關係。

cues.en: Okay, that's quite a mouthful.
cues.zh: 這說法有點繞口。

cues.en: But basically this means that the frequency of a word appearing in a text is inversely proportional to its ordinal rank.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是單字在文字中出現的頻率，與它的排名成反比。

cues.en: Well, okay, that's also just a bunch of words.
cues.zh: 好，這樣聽起來還是一堆文字。

cues.en: What does that actually mean?
cues.zh: 究竟是什麼意思？

cues.en: This characterization is expressed in a graph that looks something like this.
cues.zh: 這個特性，可以用像這樣的圖表示。

cues.en: So here on the y axis we have the frequency of words occurring in the book War and Peace.
cues.zh: y 軸是《戰爭與和平》中，單字出現的頻率。

cues.en: And then on the x axis we have the same words but just sorted according to how often they occur.
cues.zh: x 軸則是相同的單字，只是依出現頻率排序。

cues.en: So this is the actual frequency and this is the sorted frequency indices.
cues.zh: 所以，這是實際頻率，這是排序後的頻率索引。

cues.en: So these words all the way up here are going to be things like the and and so on.
cues.zh: 最上方這些字，會是 the、and 之類的字。

cues.en: And these words down here are just less frequently occurring words like phantasmagorical.
cues.zh: 下方則是較少出現的字，例如 phantasmagorical，光怪陸離的。

cues.en: I'm pretty sure that that word appears in war and peace at least once, ones.
cues.zh: 我很確定，這個字在《戰爭與和平》至少出現過一次。

cues.en: But anyway, this relationship here is not just some quirk of Tolstoy's writing style.
cues.zh: 但這個關係，不只是托爾斯泰寫作風格的特殊現象。

cues.en: You see the same phenomenon in lots of books, lots of different texts, and lots of different languages.
cues.zh: 很多書籍、不同文字，以及不同語言中，都看得到同樣現象。

cues.en: Basically, any time you apply this analysis that you are going to learn about in exercise one, you will see a relationship that looks something like this.
cues.zh: 基本上，每次套用練習一要學的分析，都會看到類似關係，

cues.en: Assuming that you have enough data now, you're not necessarily going to see this log log relationship if you're just working with a small piece of text.
cues.zh: 前提是資料夠多；如果只是短短一段文字，不一定會看到這種雙對數關係。

cues.en: But what does all this stuff mean anyway?
cues.zh: 不過，這些究竟代表什麼？

cues.en: To be honest, I'm not really sure.
cues.zh: 老實說，我也不太確定。

cues.en: But we do see things like Zipf's law occurring all over the place in nature.
cues.zh: 但自然界到處都能看到齊夫定律這類現象。

cues.en: It's also called scale free networks.
cues.zh: 也稱為無尺度網路。

cues.en: So in this diagram, the size of the circles is proportional to the number of circles.
cues.zh: 這張圖中，圓的大小與圓的數量呈比例關係。

cues.en: So there's more small circles and fewer big circles.
cues.zh: 也就是小圓多、大圓少。

cues.en: That's just another example of power law scaling.
cues.zh: 這只是冪律尺度關係的另一個例子。

cues.en: It turns out that earthquakes also follow this same principle.
cues.zh: 地震也遵循相同原理。

cues.en: So the magnitude of an earthquake is proportional in log scale to the frequency of occurrence.
cues.zh: 地震規模，與出現頻率在對數尺度下相關。

cues.en: In other words, small magnitudes happen very often, and big magnitude earthquakes happen very infrequently.
cues.zh: 換句話說，小規模地震很常見，大規模地震很少見。

cues.en: We also see this in the brain.
cues.zh: 大腦中也能看到。

cues.en: This is not my work, but my neuroscience research lab also did some investigations into scale free and power law dynamics in the brain.
cues.zh: 這不是我的研究，不過我的神經科學實驗室，也研究過大腦的無尺度與冪律動態。

cues.en: Basically, everywhere you look in biology and physics, if you have a complex system, you're going
cues.zh: 基本上，在生物學與物理學中，只要是複雜系統，

cues.en: to see power loss scaling, which in linguistics is called Zipf's law.
